title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Open Correction Requests and the Lodging of Originals
content:
For `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents`, originals come back to the line in connection with a correction only while there is a correction on the document still waiting for the customer. This page defines when such a request exists.

## Rule

1. Originals are lodged back only while the document has at least one correction request that is still awaiting the customer.
2. The number of correction requests awaiting the customer is found from the documentation service requests on the document: count every correction request on file, then deduct those whose outcome is completed, those withdrawn and those declined. What remains are the correction requests still awaiting the customer.
3. When that remainder is zero, no correction awaits the customer and nothing is lodged; the number of originals recorded is zero.

Only correction requests enter this count. Telex release, switch bill, reissue and letter-of-indemnity requests on the same document are disregarded.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Correction requests on the document | Completed, withdrawn or declined | Awaiting the customer | Lodgement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 1 | Takes place |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | Takes place |
| 2 | 2 | 0 | Nothing lodged |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | Nothing lodged |

(The figures are hypothetical.)

## Points of judgement

**The only correction request on the document was withdrawn last week. Are originals lodged now?** No. With no correction awaiting the customer, nothing is lodged.

**A telex release request is awaiting the customer, but no correction is. Does that support a lodgement for a correction?** No. Only correction requests are counted here.
